Kalibrácia

Leave the platform empty and select Zero; the controller averages 30 raw readings and does not wait for a perfectly still value. Place a known weight on the platform, enter its mass and calculate the factor the same way. Verify with a second known weight. Empty keg mass is separate from platform zero.

Not calibrated

Zero and Calculate factor compare the average of the first 15 readings with the last 15. If they differ by more than this limit, the load changed during averaging and nothing is saved. Raise it if a still but noisy scale keeps failing; lower it to catch smaller changes. The daily measurement uses the same limit.

Daily keg level and consumption

One record per scale per day, from 50 readings. The bars are the beer that left every keg that day, added together. Each keg has one line for the beer left (L). Click a legend item to show or hide that line. The chart shows all kegs, so the keg selector above does not change it. K marks a keg change, U a measurement where the load changed.

Temperature correction

t = °C, result in raw counts. Paste the formula y2tlogviewer copies.
